import importlib.util

  "max_abs_err_vs_torch_softmax": (out - ref).abs().max().item(),
  "has_nan": bool(torch.isnan(out).any()),
  "min_entry": out.min().item()
}))", "expected_signal": "row sums > 1 and nonzero max abs error vs torch.softmax"}
